channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Trump blasts Olympic skier over comments about representing U.S.
item.description: President Donald Trump criticized American Olympic skier Hunter Hess on Sunday, days after the athlete expressed mixed feelings about representing the U.S. at the Winter Olympics in northern Italy.

item.title: Alpine skier Vonn has surgery on leg after crash at Olympics
item.description: CORTINA D’AMPEZZO/TREVISO, Italy >> U.S. ski great Lindsey Vonn had surgery on a broken leg in an Italian hospital after her audacious bid to win Olympic downhill gold with a ruptured knee ligament ended in a horrific crash after 13 seconds on Sunday.

item.title: Gov. Green: Severe weather prompts state offices, UH campuses and Hawaii public schools to close Monday
item.description: All Hawaii public schools, including the University of Hawaii, will close and only essential state and county employees will report to work on Monday as a powerful winter storm continues to pound the islands, Gov. Josh Green and other state officials announced today.

item.title: Electronic curling handles are a hit at Milano Cortina Olympics
item.description: CORTINA D’AMPEZZO, Italy >> Curlers have welcomed the introduction of electronic handles on the stones at the Winter Olympics which can automatically detect and flag hog line violations, saying the technology makes the genteel sport fairer than ever.

item.title: Washington Post publisher announces departure after mass layoffs
item.description: WASHINGTON >> Washington Post publisher and CEO Will Lewis is leaving the newspaper, it announced on Saturday after carrying out widespread layoffs this week.

item.title: Super Bowl ads feature smaller portions, weight-loss drugs
item.description: Pizza, pasta or Chinese take-out used to be the go-to Super Bowl spread for Marla Senzon’s family — until the Florida retiree began taking a GLP-1 appetite-suppressing medication two years ago.

item.title: Man killed in solo ATV crash on Hawaii island
item.description: Hawaii island police are investigating a fatal single-vehicle ATV crash that occurred late Saturday night in Honokaa.

item.title: Seahawks beat Patriots 29-13 to win Super Bowl LX
item.description: Kenneth Walker III rushed for 135 yards and Seattle’s top-ranked scoring defense scored the decisive blow in a 29-13 win over the New England Patriots in Super Bowl LX at Levi’s Stadium today.

item.title: Mississippi man charged with kidnapping, sex assault on Hawaii island
item.description: A 25-year-old Biloxi, Miss., man was indicted Wednesday by a Hilo grand jury for a series of domestic incidents that allegedly occurred between Jan. 22 and 29 at a Mountain View residence.

item.title: Woman, 45, dies after crashing vehicle into tree in Waimanalo last month
item.description: A 46-year-old motorist who crashed her vehicle on Kalanianaole Highway in Waimanalo last month has died, Honolulu police said.
